data.body: Additional evidence from lead-unpleasing-kitten: `test_ran_and_skipped_coexist_in_one_run` says its skipped record represents absent scc/lizard, but on this host scc 3.7.0 is present and the test still passes because unrelated inapplicable detectors contribute skipped records. Therefore it does not prove metric present or metric absent behavior. The deterministic metric-absence nodes do force `_METRIC_CANDIDATES`, so absence accounting remains covered; the new positive metric oracle must assert the backend and detector id explicitly.
